messages:
olivia: Auditor Claire asked for a compact, replayable evidence handoff tying the infra RBAC change to KMS decrypt activity for SOC2. They want sanitized snippets + a one-page playback. Can someone take ownership?

mark: I can take the runbook + manifest. We should keep artifacts minimal: PR + approval ticket, sanitized CloudTrail for kms events, KMS key policy, rotation CSV, SIEM alert trace, rollback demo outputs, and a short threat-context note.

"auditor_claire": Thanks 1 please include: 1) infra PR that changed bindings (link + approver + timestamp), 2) authorization ticket, 3) sanitized events for kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey referencing the CMK, 4) KMS rotation history + CMK ARN, 5) SIEM correlation showing alert -> principal -> key usage, 6) replay steps showing decrypt success before change and AccessDenied after revert. Keep things redacted and replayable.

jay: Draft Splunk (will sanitize before upload):
```splunk
index=cloudtrail eventName IN (Decrypt,GenerateDataKey) requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444444444444:key/xyz-4444"
| table _time userIdentity.principalId eventName requestParameters.keyId errorMessage
| sort _time
```

mark: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/560 1 updated binding svc-httpproxy -> kms-decrypt. Approval ticket: JIRA INF-7500 approved by @mark at 2024-11-09T11:03:00Z. I'll include the PR diff snapshot (sanitized).

olivia: Add the KMS key policy export and a short envelope-encryption diagram. Also note where ephemeral data keys are cached (if any) and TTL (we cache for 300s in the model-serving tier).

jay: Sanitization jq script (example):
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-11-07T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-09T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > raw.json
jq 'map({eventTime:.eventTime, principal:.userIdentity.type, actor:.userIdentity.principalId, eventName:.eventName, keyId:.requestParameters.keyId})' raw.json > sanitized-kms.json
```

"auditor_claire": Good. For rotation proof, CSV export or screenshot is OK. Please list roles who can rotate (e.g., kms-admin, secops-service). Also include the CMK ARN.

mark: We'll include a signed manifest.txt with filenames, SHA256 checksums, and a mapping table: control ID -> artifact -> short proof statement. Example mapping line: CC-RBAC-02 -> artifacts/INF-7500/sanitized-kms.json -> shows svc-httpproxy principal invoking kms:Decrypt on CMK.

olivia: SIEM rule ID for this flow is SIEM-2024-6333. Jay, can you produce an alert replay (redacted) that shows timeline: alert -> incident ticket -> principal -> key usage?

jay: Yep. I'll assemble a short alert reproduction (redacted ids) and a Splunk saved search export. Will include field mapping: alert.alert_id, correlated_ticket, matched_event_time, principal.

mark: For rollback demo we'll capture exact commands and outputs. Test plan: generate test ciphertext with the same CMK and run decrypt under the svc-httpproxy role before change, then revert binding and rerun. We'll screenshot output and include redacted stderr/stdout. Example commands:
```bash
# before revert (expect success)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444444444444:key/xyz-4444 --profile svc-httpproxy
# after revert (expect AccessDenied)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444444444444:key/xyz-4444 --profile svc-httpproxy
```

olivia: Ops bot: where to upload?

evidence-bot: Upload path: s3://redwood-evidence/INF-7500/2024-11-09. Use presigned URLs with 48h TTL. Label files according to manifest and include manifest.txt root.

jay: We'll also include a short 'playback.sh' that replays the sanitized timeline locally (consumes sanitized-kms.json and manifest to print a step-by-step reconstruction). Auditors like runnable artifacts.

"auditor_claire": Excellent 1 please ensure all artifacts are free of PII/PHI and account numbers are redacted. Once uploaded, send the presigned bundle link and we'll schedule a 15min replay call if needed.

mark: Owners: mark (runbook + manifest + PR snapshot), jay (sanitized logs + Splunk + playback script), olivia (bundle assembly + upload). ETA: draft bundle by Friday COB.

olivia: Noted. I'll post the presigned link here when available. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
